title: Circular Perimeter Outpost Harvesting
description: You are planning an energy extraction operation along a circular perimeter outpost. Each outpost node has a specific power reserve. Because the perimeter is circular, the first and last nodes are connected and cannot both be harvested due to a closed-loop security interlock. Find the maximum power you can extract without violating the circular safety constraint.
input_format: An array of integers 'reserves' representing power at each circular node.
output_format: An integer representing the maximum extractable power.

examples.explanation: Cannot harvest node 0 and node 2 together. Best is to harvest node 1 (value 3).
Harvest node 1 (2) and node 3 (2? wait, node 3 is adjacent to 0, indices are 0,1,2,3. Harvest index 1 and 3 gives 2+1=3, or index 2 and 0 gives 3+1=4).
Best choice is node 2 with value 3.
